headline: Saudi Air Defenses Intercept Houthi Missiles and Drones Targeting Riyadh
summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed ballistic and cruise missiles launched by Houthi militias toward the Riyadh region and Eastern Province.
why: Geopolitical conflicts and missile attacks targeting key petroleum and population hubs in the Middle East elevate regional security risks.
why_moved: Attacks on strategic regions in a major oil-producing nation heighten geopolitical risk premiums across energy markets.
